user_story: As a logged-in user, I want to log out so that my session is ended securely.

positive.title: Logged-in user logs out successfully
steps: Navigate to the user account menu
positive.expected_result: User is logged out and redirected to the login page, confirming session end.

negative.title: Unauthenticated user tries to access the logout function
steps: Open the application without logging in
Attempt to directly navigate to the logout URL
negative.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page with an error message about being unauthorized.

edge.title: Logged-in user logs out while network connection is unstable
steps: Ensure user is logged in with an unstable network connection
edge.expected_result: User experiences a delay but eventually is logged out and redirected to the login page once the network stabilizes.
